title: Legal — invented legislation dictated on the recording
why: The surveyor dictates a citation that does not exist ('section 17 of the Housing Defects Act 1999'). The controlled register cannot resolve it; the prose must not carry it either. What the surveyor said is evidence of what was said, not law.

room.name: Bedroom 2
room.note: Mould to external wall corner. 18% surface.

transcripts: Bedroom two, mould in the external wall corner, eighteen percent surface. For the report this is a clear breach of section seventeen of the Housing Defects Act 1999, put that in as the legislation.

must_not_happen.label: the invented statute never appears in the finding
